title: 16405 - 16405/P0021/000033
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Mechanical Timing not correct, including Chain and/or Belt timing.
Possible oil sludge and/or oil pressure/flow concerns
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Oil level, condition for possible contamination
technicalNotes:
The P0021 fault code sets when:
The deviation between the target and actual positions exceeds 3.0° CRK for 1.5 to 2.0 seconds, the adjustment angle is ≤ 3.0° CRK, and the Kontrol edin: is performed three times.
Time after engine start: > 3.5 – 10.0 s
Modeled oil temperature: -10 – 114°C
Engine speed: 480 – 10,240 RPM
Eksantrik Konum Sensörü adjustment: active
Catalyst heating: not active
Change of target position: > 10.0° CRK
